title: Under Night In-Birth II Sys:Celes Fighting Game Reveals Trailer for DLC Character Zohar The 'Doppelganger'
content: Arc System Works revealed the trailer for the new DLC character Zohar The "Doppelganger" for Under Night In-Birth II Sys:Celes , the newest installment in French Bread's original Under Night In-Birth 2D fighting game series, at the EVO 2026 event on Saturday. The character will launch in summer 2026.
author: ANN

title: Wit Studio Reveals LONA Original TV Anime by Director Takashi Katagiri Slated for Spring 2027 Debut
content: Wit Studio revealed on Sunday a new original television anime by director Takashi Katagiri ( SPY×FAMILY Code: White film) titled LONA ( Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis ), which will debut in spring 2027.
author: ANN

title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 3 Announced
content: Wistoria: Wand and Sword Season 3 was officially announced immediately after the second season’s finale finished airing in Japan. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime worldwide, with Episode 12 set to arrive soon.
author: Anime Corner

title: WIT STUDIO Announces Original TV Anime LONA for Spring 2027, Reveals Staff, Cast, and First Trailer
content: WIT STUDIO has officially announced its next original TV anime, LONA , which is scheduled to premiere in Spring 2027. The studio also released the anime’s first teaser trailer, teaser commercial, and three teaser visuals while revealing its main staff and cast.
author: Anime Corner

title: Shonen Jump’s Major 2026 Cancellation Officially Confirmed as a Huge Mistake
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine continues its wave of cancellations as it hits one of its most promising series. Alien Headbutt is Akira Inui’s first serialized manga, and while fans noticed the promising elements in the story, the magazine didn’t give it a chance to shine.
author: ComicBook

title: Singer, Actor Akihiro Miwa Dies at 91
content: The official website for actor, voice actor, and singer Akihiro Miwa (real name Ahihiro Maruyama) announced on Sunday that Miwa died on June 20 of old age. He was 91. Miwa's agency stated that due to his advanced age he had been cutting back on work over the last year.
author: ANN

title: 18 Years Later, Netflix’s Avatar: The Last Airbender Gives Us 1 Team-Up We Deserved in the Original Show
content: Eighteen years after the original show’s ending, Netflix’s Avatar: The Last Airbender gives fans an epic team-up in Season 2 — and it’s one we deserved in the animated series. Netflix’s ATLA adaptation is officially back, and it’s already dominating discussions online.
author: ComicBook

title: The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me Premieres in October, Releases Promo Material
content: The production company behind the anime adaptation of Kazami Sawatari’s The Salty Koharu Has a Soft Spot for Me has released a promo video ahead of its October premiere. Alongside the promo video, staff news, and a visual were released. Fumihiro Yoshimura will direct the upcoming rom-com anime.
author: Anime Corner
